FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Aspen Ridge Pipelines Inc.
REPORTED BY
Area supervisor
RECEIVED VIA
Text messages
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
"just had a release on our line near Edmonton, AB at 20:25 on Sept 10. volume metered at 166
m³. looks like it went off the ROW onto neighbouring land. still assessing the situation. flange
failure is suspected, possibly due to frozen gasket. ground was frozen solid in the area and we
had some pretty bad freeze-thaw issues last spring. will keep you posted on what's going on. - J.
Smith, Area Supervisor"
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
